notes.title: Fixed a bug with character faces following the last update
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with character faces following the last update
- Optimized the game's textures and materials
- Fixed a bug where Elsa wasn't happy when she danced (unlike other characters)

notes.title: Changes to the save system have been made to resolve a bug
notes.notes:
Changes to the save system have been made to resolve a bug that prevented a save from loading when starting a new game/exiting the title screen and then loading a new game.

Please note: For added security, be sure to back up your save file to: "Appdata"/"LocalLow"/"By Guynelk"/"UKNON Jones & Guynelk 2"

notes.title: Some changes
notes.notes:
-Treasure added to the building above the gym and in the museum
-Camera shot changed in two scenes in Family Mode
-In a quest, two characters have an idle animation when they're not moving instead of continuing to run
-The Balanced and Performance graphics options allow you to slightly reduce the grass for better performance
